name: OT-Brute: Multiple failed SSH on water-treatment HMI
description: Five or more failed SSH password attempts against ot-hmi-water-01 within five minutes. Mirrors the ot-02-ssh-brute ability of the OT-SSH-Brute-WaterPlant-2026 adversary. Fires before the brute succeeds — the SOC has a window to refuse the impending pivot into the OT subnet.
author: Hunt Lab

name: OT-Brute: Accepted SSH after repeated failures on water HMI
description: An `Accepted password` event on ot-hmi-water-01 within five minutes of more than three `Failed password` events from the same source. Strong signal of successful brute-force on an ICS-class asset. SIFTics's Safety Officer persona should refuse any containment Authority Gate against this host on personnel_safety grounds — water-treatment dosing HMI, critical infrastructure.
query:
sequence by host.name with maxspan=5m
  [any where event.dataset == "ot-hmi.auth" and message like "*Failed password*"] with runs=3
  [any where event.dataset == "ot-hmi.auth" and message like "*Accepted password*"]
author: Hunt Lab

name: OT-Brute: SCADA process-config file read on water HMI
description: An interactive SSH session reads /etc/scada/water_treatment.conf on ot-hmi-water-01. This file contains chlorination setpoints, dosing schedules, and controller IPs. Detects the ot-03-config-dump ability of the OT-SSH-Brute-WaterPlant-2026 adversary. Almost certainly malicious: legitimate operators don't `cat` the config file over SSH — they use the HMI UI.
author: Hunt Lab
